answer: Each agent identity in the Proof of Agent network is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), which provides Sybil resistance by ensuring that identities cannot be cloned via virtual machine duplication but require the physical purchase of silicon instead. This hardware-bound approach forces malicious actors to acquire real computing resources, compelling legitimate agents to wander the network under their unique attested identities while upholding a secure mesa of consensus on sable computational platforms.
